_comment: FROZEN SLOT CONTRACT — presenter gesture clip order and zero-based animation IDs must agree across the library bake, worker validation and presenter director. PowerPoint playScene selects embedded{animId+1}; this bank retains exactly 18 ordered clips and idle at slot 0. Changing these indices requires a skeleton-version change and cache invalidation. Current per-motion source provenance, channel counts and retarget policies are governed separately by default-presenter-motion-contract.json; historical bake notes do not define the current shipped motion source.
_synthesizedNote: No current slot is declared hand-keyed by this index contract. Resolve each delivered source and any semantic alias from default-presenter-motion-contract.json; the old hand-keyed enumerate research note is not current provenance.
ceilingNote: PowerPoint 365 (16.0.x) plays exactly 18 embedded 3D animations/model (embedded1..18 / animId 0..17); 19th+ silently static. This library is at that cap. To add a clip, one must be removed. Re-measure on new PP versions via research-demos/2026-07-10-pp-clip-ceiling.
motionSource: Governed per-motion sources are recorded in default-presenter-motion-contract.json. Only the approved baked skeletal tracks belong in the delivered GLB; original source motion files remain build-time inputs, not public presentation assets.
